description: This file defines the 'Footnote' class as part of the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel, representing a footnote element within a document. It includes constructors, methods to add content (paragraphs, tables, images), properties for formatting and referencing, serialization for document export, and supporting internal classes for property values.

classes.name: Footnote
classes.description: Represents a footnote element in a document, allowing for creation, cloning, deep copying, and managing footnote content such as paragraphs, tables, and images.

classes.name: Footnote.FootnoteValues
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating nullable property values for the Footnote, including elements, reference marker, style, and formatting.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a paragraph with optional text to the footnote.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a table to the footnote.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the footnote by name.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an existing paragraph, table, or image to the footnote.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the footnote instance.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the footnote into a format suitable for document export.
